name: agent-wrangler-personas
description: Agent Wrangler extension shipping opt-in operational personas, starting with the Mob group: `mob-boss` and `mob-worker`.

wranglerExtension.label: Personas
wranglerExtension.description: Adds opt-in operational personas for Agent Wrangler sessions. The Mob group ships `mob-boss`, which decomposes and dispatches work, and `mob-worker`, which owns one bounded deliverable. Ordinary sessions are unaffected until a persona is explicitly requested.
wranglerExtension.author: psjamesh
